name: Default
shortDescription: Java I2P router for the anonymous I2P network, with its web router console, I2PSnark torrent client and hidden service manager.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated password stored in the router.config mount (consolePassword). It is applied on the first start only; change it later under Configure > UI in the router console.
The I2NP transport port is not published, so the router runs in firewalled mode. It still builds tunnels and reaches the network, but routes less traffic for other peers.
